request.query: Register EU citizen's right of residence (EU registration)

sources.title: migri.fi
highlights: Apply for the registration of your right of residence (EU registration) if
If you cannot use Enter Finland, fill in a paper application
originals and copies of the documents that you attach to your application

sources.title: ihhelsinki.fi
highlights: If you stay in Finland for longer than 90 days, you need to visit the Finnish Immigration Service (Migri) to register your EU citizen’s right of residence
Remember to bring your identity card or passport to your appointment
If you do not pay the application fee in EnterFinland, you will also need a debit or credit card in your appointment
New appointments to visit Migri at IHH open every Thursday between 14-16 for the following week

sources.title: ihhelsinki.fi
highlights: Documentation on the grounds for your move to Finland (for example employment, education, family ties, studies: check the exact requirements on Migri’s website
Within 90 days of your arrival and once the grounds for your registration are valid, e.g. employment has started
The decision can be given as soon as the requirements are met
IHH services linked to this step Visit IHH at Lintulahdenkuja 2 D, 00530 Helsinki Registration of an EU citizen’s right of residence Newcomer Information Sessions
